_readme: Where each part of your database feeds the solve builder. Edit freely, then run: python3 run.py import <export.json>. Nothing is read until this file says where it goes. Unmapped kinds go to 'rumors' and are reported.

poem._note: The poem document (20 lines) becomes the poem the tool works from if you have not pasted one yet. Line ids l01..l20 are translated to S#L# refs.

intel._note: 223 records. 'kind' decides which layer a record feeds. 'conf' plus kind decides its reliability tier. Records whose kind is not listed here go to rumors.
intel._tier_note: Your 'likely' statements become 'reported' (not 'confirmed') because most were compiled by Mysterious Writings or THAP rather than quoted from a dated primary source. Change a row here if you disagree.

candidates._note: 36 solve/site records. Each with coordinates becomes a 'site' feature in the landmark inventory (tier below). Each with a chain (12 of them) also becomes a read-only reference solve you can compare against.

mapStates._note: States marked 'eliminated' (CO, OR) are added to the eliminated-states rule. The other statuses and your notes are kept as settings and shown on the map.

readings._note: Empty in the export (0 records) — nothing to map yet.
